protocol.scope: Nations League target matches; common paired sample, official national-team history only
protocol.development: Calendar 2024–2025; 2023 is warm-up. Descriptive only; no parameter search.
protocol.evaluation: Calendar 2026; fixed candidate configuration, no tuning on these outcomes.
protocol.baseline: Frozen xgMarketModel, prior2/half-life90, Nations League history only; no xG for these data.
protocol.candidate: Regularized attack/defence strengths adjusted to opponent strength; pooled official national-team history.
protocol.predictionTime: 08:00 Europe/Lisbon on each match day; simultaneous matches share the same historical cutoff.
protocol.historicalAvailability: RETROSPECTIVE EVENT-TIME RECONSTRUCTION. Results assumed available kickoff+2h. Actual import/revision clocks were mostly later and do not prove contemporary availability.
protocol.tournamentVenue: Candidate treats final tournaments (World Cup/Euro) as neutral unless independently verified otherwise. Legacy neutral field is not trusted.
protocol.uncertainty: Paired metric-difference percentile intervals from 2000 bootstrap samples of whole match days; per-market Wilson intervals are binomial approximations.
protocol.selectionBias: No best parameters or market selection are chosen from evaluation outcomes. Raw model diagnostics do not validate the 50/50 blend or accumulator selection.
protocol.acceptance: Report paired comparison and coverage without forcing a passing result. No empirical win-rate guarantee, ROI claim or deployment decision is produced.
protocol.odds: Historical contemporaneous Betano odds are not supplied: no valid accumulator hit-rate or profitability backtest.

structuralFeasibilityExample.note: Demonstrates mathematical compatibility of guards only. These are not real selections or claimed odds.

limitations: Retrospective event-time reconstruction; incomplete early history and real import-time availability cannot be established.
No historical odds supplied; evaluates raw national-team model, not 50/50 Betano blend or complete ticket rules.
Only one available Nations League evaluation period; teams and match days are dependent.
Fixed conservative sample/recency policy is not a statistical confidence interval.
Model probability calibration requires continued monitoring; a lower average error does not validate every probability band.
